theater: 河朔朔州太原一線邊塞

battle.name: 突厥攻隋之戰
battle.theater: 河朔朔州太原一線邊塞
battle.brief: 開皇元年冬，東突厥沙摩羅可汗乘隋代周立國、邊防未固，率眾入寇朔州、太原一線。隋以河間王楊誼屯河朔，遣韓擒虎、虞慶等出塞拒之，次年追擊於朔州以北，斬獲頗眾。卡面那件埃及長矛並非戰場之物，它代表長矛的源流：隋軍以步槊、拒馬列陣禦騎，突厥騎手以套馬桿長矛衝鋒。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 此役的交戰方是隋朝與漠北的東突厥。開皇元年二月，楊堅受北周恭帝禪讓，建立隋朝，改元開皇；同年冬，東突厥大汗沙摩羅可汗便乘新朝草創、邊軍改編未畢之際率眾南侵，兵鋒直指河朔的朔州、太原一線。隋朝在北邊沿用北周的軍鎮舊制而改設總管府：並州總管府領山西全境，靈州總管府扼住河套南緣，夏州都督府屯統萬城，朔州、雲州、寰州一線的邊堡與墩堠構成北面的屏障。開皇元年，隋文帝把北周留下的邊鎮兵編入府兵體系，歸各州總管與柱國調遣，並在長城沿線設屯田監，招募民戶實邊、墾種輸粟。突厥一側是游牧部落的聯盟體：沙摩羅可汗駐於於都斤山一帶的汗庭，以控弦之眾號令五百餘部，牧地自金山、阿爾泰山延伸至陰山與朔方，兵以輕騎為主、步卒為輔，逐水草而徙，塞外以牙帳、旗鼓、鼓角為號令。兩造之間還夾著吐谷渾與高昌等西域政權，隋朝則以河西走廊的驛站、屯田與和親並用，試圖把北方的壓力分散在幾條線上。這場戰爭的規模並不算大，卻正撞在新朝最需要安穩的時節。
countriesEn: The two parties in this conflict were the Sui dynasty and the Eastern Turks of the northern steppe. In the second month of 581 Yang Jian accepted the abdication of the Northern Zhou emperor and founded the Sui, opening the Kaihuang era; that same winter the great khan of the Eastern Turks, Shaboluo, moved in while the new dynasty's frontier command was still being reorganised, driving his forces south toward Shuo and Taiyuan along the northern bank of the Yellow River. The Sui kept the Zhou military-district system but converted it into regional inspectorates: Bingzhou at Taiyuan held all of Shanxi, Lingzhou guarded the southern edge of the Ordos loop, and Xiadu commanded the garrison town of Tongwan, while the border forts of Shuo, Yun and Huan formed the northern screen. In 581 Yang Jian folded the old Zhou frontier garrisons into the fubing system under the provincial commanders and pillar generals, and set up agricultural colonies along the Great Wall, settling households on the frontier to grow grain. The Turkic side was a nomadic confederation: Shaboluo held his khagan seat near the Ondiq mountains, commanded over five hundred divisions, pastured horses and sheep from the Altai to the Yin mountains and the desert south of the Ordos, and fought with light cavalry and some foot, living in tents and shifting with the grass. Between the two lay the Western regions, Tuyuhun and Gaochang, while the Sui combined frontier garrisons, relay stations, colonies and marriage diplomacy to hold the Turks on several fronts. The war was modest in scale, but it landed at the moment the new dynasty most needed quiet on its northern frontier.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩邊。隋文帝楊堅是此役的決策者：他在北周末年已把軍權與財權收攏於內府，登基後對北方採取守禦為主、不輕啟反攻的態度，同時默許朝中以離間之策分化突厥內部。河間王楊誼是開皇元年受命屯兵河朔的行軍統帥，負責統率河套、朔方一線的接應；上柱國韓擒虎與虞慶則率兵出塞，正面與突厥騎兵交鋒，虞慶出身北方邊鎮，是隋朝倚重的邊將；尚書左僕射楊素後在開皇五年再度出塞討突厥，主持追擊與掃蕩。晉王楊廣於開皇元年封王並領並州總管，鎮守山西前線，是隋朝在北方最被看重的宗室，他此後在北方累積的軍功與歷練，都與邊防綁在一起。突厥方面的核心是沙摩羅可汗本人，他是阿史那氏的大汗，控制漠北五百餘部，開皇元年拒絕交出前北周送嫁的金千公主，又向隋廷索取中國式的待遇，兩造交涉破裂才引來這場兵事；其部帥阿波實力僅次於他，開皇二年起兩人互相攻伐，隋朝正是利用這一內鬨坐大。沙摩羅之子和碩後來被隋朝冊為啟民可汗，成為隋在漠北的傀儡兼姻親。執行離間的則是長孫晟，他在開皇三年奉命出使突厥，往返數次，逐步把沙摩羅與阿波之間的猜忌推向全面內戰。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fall into two camps. Sui Emperor Wen, Yang Jian, was the man in charge of the decision: he had already drawn military and financial power into the imperial household in the last years of Northern Zhou, and once enthroned he adopted a defence-first attitude on the northern frontier, never lightly launching a counter-offensive, while quietly allowing the court to pursue a policy of sowing division inside the Turks. Prince of Hedong Yang Yi received command of the army holding the river's northern bend and was responsible for the reaction force along the Ordos and Shuofang lines; the pillar generals Han Qinhu and Yu Qing took troops beyond the frontier to meet the Turkic cavalry head-on, and Yu Qing, a man from a northern border family, was one of the Sui's most trusted frontier commanders. The Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Yang Su, would lead another campaign against the Turks in Kaihuang 5, directing the pursuit and the mopping up. Prince Jin, Yang Guang, was enfeoffed in 581 and took command of Bingzhou at Taiyuan, holding the Shanxi front; he was the royal heir the Sui most relied upon in the north, and the military credit and the hard experience he accumulated on the northern frontier stayed tied to frontier defence from then on. At the centre of the Turkic side was Shaboluo Qaghan himself, the khan of the Ashina clan, master of more than five hundred divisions of the northern steppe. In 581 he refused to hand over the gold princess the former Northern Zhou had married off to him, and demanded Chinese-style treatment from the Sui court; only after the negotiations broke down did this war come about. His rival Abō, the next strongest of his commanders, began fighting him for the khanship in Kaihuang 2, and the Sui grew strong precisely by feeding that civil war. Shaboluo's son Kesho was later invested by the Sui as Qimin Qaghan, becoming at once a puppet and a marriage tie of the Sui in the northern steppe. The man who carried out the divide-and-rule was Zhangsun Sheng, sent to the Turks on mission in Kaihuang 3 and several times thereafter, steadily turning the mutual suspicion between Shaboluo and Abō into an all-out civil war.
kits: 卡面那件埃及長矛本身並不在開皇元年的塞北，它是這件兵器的源流起點：早王朝的埃及人把銅或青銅矛頭縛在木杆上，用它守城垣，也用它收復失地。此後數千年，長矛這一類兵器在各地戰場換過無數副模樣，卻始終是步兵結陣與騎兵衝鋒之間最通用的武器。落到隋與突厥的戰場上，長矛分裂成兩條路。隋軍這邊有步槊，槊身長過一丈，握在虎口裡既可刺也可揮，用來把騎兵擋在陣前；有標槊，隨身帶在腰側、在騎兵接近前擲出；有拒馬與鹿角，把削尖的木樁和交叉的枝架成障，逼得突厥馬匹無法直衝而改走迂迴；還有橫刀與狼牙棒，補在槊兵輪換下來的空隙。弓弩方面，隋軍用蹶張弩與拉力更大、射速更低的弩機，壓制騎兵接近的路徑，步卒則張弓掩護。突厥那邊的長矛是套在馬上的騎槊與標槊，總量不多，多配給列在前鋒的射手與近戰突騎，配合角弓、複合反曲弓與馬刀使用；皮甲配穹廬箭壺，行動全靠馬匹與帳幕，另有套索與繩索在追擊與擄掠時派上用場。除兵器之外，這場戰爭真正決定勝負的裝備是馬：突厥以馬立國，控弦之眾與馬群相繫；隋軍則靠並州、靈州沿線的屯田、驛傳車隊與徵發的民夫，把糧秣運上雁門、陰山一線的堡寨。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear shown on the card was not present in the northern steppe in 581; it is the ancestor of the weapon type. The Egyptians of the Early Dynastic period bound a copper or bronze head to a wooden shaft, used it to hold city walls and later to recover lost ground. Over the following millennia the spear took countless new forms on battlefields everywhere, yet it remained the most universal weapon between an infantry formation and a charging cavalry line. On the Sui and Turkic battlefields the spear split into two traditions. On the Sui side there was the step-spear, a shafted weapon more than one zhang long, gripped in the fist so that it could be thrust or swung, used to keep cavalry off the front of the formation; there were javelins, carried at the waist and thrown before the horsemen closed; there were cheval-de-frise stakes and antler-shaped obstacles, sharpened timbers and crossed brush set up as barriers that forced Turkic horses to swerve instead of charging straight in; and there were sabres and wolf-tooth clubs to cover the gaps when spear ranks rotated. For bows and crossbows the Sui used strongman-drawn crossbows and larger, slower-loading engine crossbows to shape the routes the horsemen could take, while the foot shot volleys of arrows in support. On the Turkic side the spear appeared as a lance carried in the saddle and as a javelin; the numbers were small, and they were issued mainly to the skirmishers at the head of the formation and to the close-in shock riders, used together with the horn bow, the composite recurve bow and the sabre. Leather armour was paired with gorytos-style arrow cases, movement depended entirely on horses and tents, and lassos and cords came into play during pursuit and plunder. Beyond weapons, the equipment that truly decided this war was the horse: the Turks were a polity built on horses, and their numbers of riders were bound to their herds. The Sui, for their part, drew on the colonies, relay wagons and conscripted labour of the Bingzhou and Lingzhou lines to carry grain and provisions up to the forts along Yumen and the Yin mountains.
tactics: 兩邊的打法幾乎是兩套完全不同的邏輯。突厥是標準的草原騎兵戰法：不紮營、不攻城，靠斥候與游騎先把隋邊的烽燧、屯田與烽火線探明；大隊逼近後不直接撞陣，而是分成數隊繞射箭矢，誘隋軍離開堡寨，然後在隋軍陣形鬆動的一刻收攏為密集的鋒矢，一齊用套馬桿與馬刀壓上；打不穿便縱馬掠走，把戰場變成追逐與擄掠，糧秣、牲畜、衣物全部帶回牙帳，隋朝邊地因此年年失收。隋軍這邊的原則是守：堡寨、關城與長城沿線的墩堠構成第一道線，步卒憑城垣與拒馬列槊陣，弩手居前控弩，弓手在後放箭，騎兵不與突厥在開闊地硬碰，只在堡寨之間的通道與隘口截擊潰退之敵；出塞追擊時則以長城既有的烽燧為節點推進，務必不讓隊伍與糧隊脫節，因為替地作戰最怕的就是被輕騎斷了糧道。另一條戰術線在外交與心理：隋朝不斷遣使播弄沙摩羅與阿波的舊怨，鼓勵對方內鬥，讓突厥的精力自己消耗在漠北；開皇三年之後正是這條線奏效，突厥分為東西兩部，北邊的壓力從此再也沒有合併過。
tacticsEn: The two sides fought by almost opposite logic. The Turks used the standard steppe cavalry method: they did not pitch camps and did not storm towns, but sent out scouts and ranging parties first to map the Sui frontier, its beacon towers, its colonies and its fire-signal line. When the main body closed, it did not strike the formation head-on; it split into several bands that shot around the flanks, luring the Sui troops out of their forts, and then, at the moment the Sui line loosened, drew itself together into a dense wedge that pressed home with the saddle lance and the sabre. When it could not break through, it rode away with the plunder, turning the battlefield into a pursuit and a raid, carrying off grain, livestock and clothing back to the khagan's tents; the Sui border lands therefore lost their harvest year after year. The Sui principle was to hold. Forts, passes and the beacon towers along the Great Wall formed the first line; the foot fought from the ramparts and from among the cheval-de-frise, ranks of spears in front, strongman crossbows controlling the approach, archers loose behind them. The Sui cavalry avoided meeting the Turks in open ground and struck only at the corridors and defiles between the forts to cut off those already beaten. When they pursued beyond the frontier, they advanced from one existing beacon tower to the next, refusing to let the fighting column and the supply column separate, because campaigning in the steppe is above all else an affair of not letting light cavalry cut the supply route. The second line of strategy lay in diplomacy and morale: the Sui kept sending envoys to stir up the old quarrel between Shaboluo and Abō and to encourage their civil war, letting the Turks exhaust themselves in the northern steppe. After Kaihuang 3 this line was what worked, the Turks split into eastern and western halves, and the pressure from the north was never united again.
data: 關於兵力與損失，史籍留下的數字不多，而且需要小心看待。《隋書·突厥傳》記開皇元年沙摩羅可汗與阿波等五百餘部入寇，號稱控弦之士四十萬、騎兵二十萬；這是草原聯盟會師時的傳統誇大數，實際到陣的部眾遠少於此。同一批記載說隋軍出塞，斬首千餘級，或記斬獲數萬級，多為統帥報功之辭，方向可信而數目不必逐位細究。可以確定的是三件事。其一，衝突發生在開皇元年冬到開皇二年春之間，戰場是河朔的朔州、太原以北的邊塞，距離朔州城數百里即是游牧地帶，騎兵一日即可往復，因此來去主要由水源與草場決定，而非由城郭決定。其二，隋朝投入的是正兵而非偏師，柱國級別的將領韓擒虎與虞慶同時受命，說明文帝對此戰的定性不是小股寇邊，而是可能牽動整條北邊防線的入寇。其三，隋朝在戰後沒有一鼓作氣深入漠北，攻到邊境即止，轉而把兵力配置在並州、靈州沿線的堡寨與屯田上；這種築城而不求深入的部署，需要大量徭役與運輸投入，僅河朔一線的軍糧供應就構成本朝財政的固定負擔。時間上，隋朝用一年多把這條防線從純粹的城防改造成城、屯、驛、烽四位一體，靠的不是一場大勝，而是無數次小戰與無數次徵發。
dataEn: Few figures survive about the forces and losses in this war, and they need to be handled with care. The History of Sui, in its chapter on the Turks, records that in 581 Shaboluo Qaghan entered the frontier together with Abō and more than five hundred divisions, claiming forty tens of thousands of bowmen and two hundred thousand horsemen; this is the traditional exaggeration of a steppe confederate muster, and far fewer men actually reached the field. The same sources say the Sui troops who went out beyond the frontier cut off a thousand or so heads, or in other places tens of thousands; these are commanders' reports of merit, reliable as to direction but not to be checked digit by digit. Three things can be established. First, the clash fell between the winter of Kaihuang 1 and the spring of Kaihuang 2, on the frontier north of Shuo and Taiyuan in the river's northern bend; a few hundred li from the city of Shuo the steppe began, and horsemen could ride out and back in a day, so movement was governed by water and pasture rather than by walls. Second, the Sui committed regular troops rather than a detachment, and pillar generals of the rank of Han Qinhu and Yu Qing were given command at the same time, which shows that the emperor regarded this not as a small raid on the border but as an incursion that could pull on the whole northern line. Third, after the war the Sui did not press on into the northern steppe; they stopped at the frontier and instead concentrated troops in the forts and colonies along the Bingzhou and Lingzhou lines. A system of building walls without seeking depth demands a great deal of corvée labour and transport, and the grain for the river's northern bend alone became a standing charge on the dynasty's finances. In terms of time, it took the Sui more than a year to turn that line from a pure wall defence into a single system of fort, colony, relay and beacon, and the reason was not one great victory but countless small actions and countless levies.
cause: 打起來的直接原因有三層。第一層是王朝更替造成的空隙：北周末年，楊堅已掌控朝政，卻仍以周的名義對外交往，沙摩羅可汗與北周的婚姻與互市關係照舊維持；開皇元年二月隋朝代周而立，這層默契隨之消失，突厥一方的心裡是中國易主、可乘之機。第二層是外交上的正面衝突：沙摩羅自視為漠北大汗，遣使入隋要求通婚並索取中國式的待遇，隋文帝不許，也不接受他的使者往來，此後突厥的使節被拒在塞外，兩造的往來就此斷裂。第三層是內部繼承：沙摩羅與阿波各自握有兵眾，誰都知道汗位之爭早晚要攤牌，外部壓力正好提供了藉口，讓兩人先用刀劍分贓。此外還有更遠的一層：隋文帝心裡真正的目標是讓突厥自己消耗，他寧可守住邊塞，也不願替突厥人消弭內鬥，於是邊軍只求挫其鋒芒，不求斬首於漠北。
causeEn: There are three layers to the immediate cause. The first is the gap opened by a change of dynasty. In the last years of Northern Zhou, Yang Jian already controlled the government, but foreign relations still ran under the Zhou name, and the marriage and the mutual trade between Shaboluo Qaghan and the Zhou continued undisturbed. When the Sui replaced the Zhou in the second month of 581 that understanding vanished with it, and on the Turkic side the calculation was that China had changed hands and the moment had come. The second layer is a direct diplomatic collision. Shaboluo regarded himself as khan of the northern steppe and sent envoys to the Sui demanding a marriage alliance and Chinese-style treatment; Emperor Wen refused, and refused his envoys, after which Turkic emissaries were kept out beyond the frontier and intercourse between the two was severed. The third layer is inheritance. Shaboluo and Abō each held troops of their own, and both knew that the question of the khanship would one day have to be settled in the open; outside pressure gave them the excuse to divide the spoils with the sword first. There is also a more distant layer: what Emperor Wen really wanted was for the Turks to exhaust themselves. He would rather hold the frontier than do the Turks' work of settling their internal quarrel for them, and so the frontier army was told only to blunt their assault, not to chase them into the northern steppe for a count of the slain.
impact: 這一仗本身沒有決定性成果，但它把隋朝對北方的整套做法逼了出來，並在後來十餘年裡定型。第一，防守帶來了成本：沿長城修築堡寨、設烽燧、置屯田，消耗大量人力與財力，隋文帝寧可忍受這份負擔，也沒有在開皇初年組織大規模的反攻。第二，和親與離間被制度化：開皇三年長孫晟出使突厥，往返數次，把沙摩羅與阿波的猜忌做成全面內戰；開皇四年，隋朝以義成公主出嫁沙摩羅之子和碩，在朔州為他設帳，冊為啟民可汗；開皇五年，楊素與虞慶出塞再戰，於朔州一線大破突厥，斬獲數萬級，北方邊患自此緩解。第三，突厥由此分裂為東西兩部：漠北以啟民可汗為中心的東突厥實力大損、內附於隋，金山以阿史那莫葛為首的西突厥崛起，成為隋朝新的西域對手，隋朝不得不把經營重點轉向河西，涼州、瓜州一線的屯田與驛站因此加速。第四，這套守邊、屯田、和親、離間並行的政策為隋唐所沿用：唐初對頗利可汗的戰與盟是同一條邏輯的延伸；長安與洛陽的繁榮之所以能在北方邊患不斷的情況下維持，靠的正是這條線後方那片由屯田與城寨撐起的邊地。
impactEn: The battle itself achieved nothing decisive, but it forced the Sui to formulate its whole northern policy, and that policy was fixed over the following decade and more. First, defence carried a price: raising forts along the Great Wall, manning beacon towers and planting colonies consumed large amounts of labour and wealth, and Emperor Wen preferred to bear that burden rather than launch a major counter-offensive in the early Kaihuang years. Second, marriage and division were institutionalised. In Kaihuang 3 Zhangsun Sheng went to the Turks, crossing back and forth several times and turning the mutual suspicion of Shaboluo and Abō into a full civil war. In Kaihuang 4 the Sui married the Yicheng princess to Kesho, Shaboluo's son, set up a tented camp for him at Shuo and invested him as Qimin Qaghan. In Kaihuang 5 Yang Su and Yu Qing went out beyond the frontier again and broke the Turks on the Shuo line, cutting off and destroying tens of thousands of men, and the northern threat eased from that point. Third, the Turks split into eastern and western halves. The eastern Turks under Qimin in the northern steppe were badly weakened and attached themselves to the Sui, while the western Turks under Ashina Moge rose on the Golden Mountain and became a new rival for the Sui in the western regions, forcing the Sui to shift the focus of its work to Hexi, accelerating the colonies and relay stations along the Liangzhou and Guazhou lines. Fourth, this policy of holding the frontier, planting colonies, marrying and dividing was carried on by the Tang: the campaigns and the treaty with Qaghan Jieli in the early Tang were the extension of the same logic, and the prosperity of Chang'an and Luoyang could be sustained despite unbroken trouble on the northern frontier only because of the belt of frontier land held up by those colonies and forts behind the line.
result: 打完之後，隋朝保住了邊塞，突厥沒有取得攻入內地的戰果，但也沒有被徹底打垮。沙摩羅可汗在開皇初年的內鬥中節節退敗，開皇二年之後他與阿波的爭鬥全面化，隋朝站在其中一邊，讓突厥內戰延續，同時把自己的軍隊壓在朔州、太原一線的堡寨裡，不再主動深入。開皇五年春，楊素、虞慶等率兵再出塞，在朔州以北的邊地與突厥主力相遇，隋軍以步兵方陣與弩箭正面硬撼騎兵衝鋒，斬獲數萬級，突厥遠走陰山以北；這一仗之後，漠北的攻勢在開皇一朝餘下十餘年裡都沒有恢復。開皇四年，隋朝把義成公主嫁給沙摩羅之子和碩，於朔州設啟民帳，用和親把這位新汗綁在隋朝一邊；開皇三年起執行的離間計策則徹底改變了北方的政治地圖，突厥從此分為東西兩部，力量再未統一，直到隋亡之後，唐朝仍要面對頗利可汗與突利系的反覆攻掠。可以這樣說，這場戰爭的直接結果是一條守住但沒有收復的邊界線，以及一個被隋朝用外交手段拆開的敵人。
resultEn: When the fighting was over, the Sui had kept its frontier, the Turks had gained no foothold inside the empire, and yet they had not been broken either. Shaboluo Qaghan retreated step by step in the civil war of the early Kaihuang years; after Kaihuang 2 the struggle between him and Abō became total, the Sui backed one side and let the Turkic civil war run on, while keeping its own troops compressed into the forts along the Shuo and Taiyuan lines and no longer taking the initiative to go deep. In the spring of Kaihuang 5 Yang Su, Yu Qing and others went out beyond the frontier again and met the main Turkic force in the borderland north of Shuo; the Sui infantry squares and their crossbow volleys took the cavalry charge head on, tens of thousands of the enemy were cut down, and the Turks fled beyond the Yin mountains. After that battle the offensive in the northern steppe did not return for the remaining dozen years of the Kaihuang reign. In Kaihuang 4 the Sui married the Yicheng princess to Kesho, Shaboluo's son, set up the Qimin camp at Shuo, and tied this new khan to the Sui through marriage; and the policy of division carried out from Kaihuang 3 onward permanently redrew the political map of the north. The Turks split into eastern and western halves and were never reunited in strength, and long after the Sui had fallen the Tang still had to face the repeated raids of Qaghan Jieli and his line. In short, the direct result of this war was a boundary line that was held but not recovered, and an enemy taken apart by the Sui's diplomacy.
